text: Entry Requirements 1.General Requirements Generally, applicants for undergraduate programs should be between 18-25 years old, applicants must be non-Chinese citizens who are physically and mentally healthy. You should hold valid foreign passports, and have completed your previous stage of study (applicants who have not yet graduated at the time of application must provide a pre-graduation certificate and obtain relevant diplomas before registration). 2. Nationality Requirements Requirements of the regulations set in the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC shall be met. 3. Language Proficiency Requirements Applicants for undergraduate programs must pass the HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) Level 4 or provide proof of equivalent Chinese language ability. *Applicants for the Chinese Language and Literature (Business Chinese) program are exempt from the Chinese proficiency requirement. Note: Tuition fee for Arts and English-Taught Majors: second, third and four years: second, third and four years: 18,000 yuan (58,000 yuan for CUZ Huace School of Film).
